local priceCache = {}
function M.displayPrice(id, isPass, fallback)
    id = tonumber(id) or 0
    if id <= 0 then return fallback end
    local c = priceCache[id]
    if c and os.clock() - c.at < 600 then return c.price or fallback end
    local ok, info = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(id, isPass and Enum.InfoType.GamePass or Enum.InfoType.Product)
    end)
    local price = ok and type(info) == "table" and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or nil
    priceCache[id] = { at = os.clock(), price = price }
    if price and fallback and price ~= fallback then
        warn(("[Monetization] %s %d costs %d R$ on Roblox but the config says %d")
            :format(isPass and "pass" or "product", id, price, fallback))
    end
    return price or fallback
end

function M.validate()
    local products, passes, problems, unset = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local function check(seen, label, id)
        id = tonumber(id) or 0
        if id <= 0 then
            table.insert(unset, label)
        elseif seen[id] then
            table.insert(problems, ("%s and %s use the same id %d"):format(seen[id], label, id))
        else
            seen[id] = label
        end
    end
    for key, e in pairs(M.GAME_PASSES) do check(passes, key, e.passId) end
    for _, t in ipairs(M.SPEED_PASS_TIERS) do check(passes, "SpeedPass x" .. t.mult, t.passId) end
    for _, e in ipairs(M.SPEED_PACKS) do check(products, e.key, e.productId) end
    for _, e in ipairs(M.CASH_PACKS) do check(products, e.key, e.productId) end
    for key, e in pairs(M.NEST) do check(products, key, e.productId) end
    for id, e in pairs(M.TRAILS) do check(products, "Trail_" .. id, e.productId) end
    for kind, u in pairs(M.UPGRADES) do
        for level, id in ipairs(u.productIds) do
            check(products, ("Upgrade_%s_%d"):format(kind, level), id)
        end
    end
    for key, e in pairs(M.GIFT_PASS_PRODUCTS) do check(products, "Gift_" .. key, e.productId) end
    check(products, "RebirthSkip", M.REBIRTH_SKIP and M.REBIRTH_SKIP.productId)
    for _, p in ipairs(problems) do warn("[Monetization] " .. p) end
    if #unset > 0 then
        warn(("[Monetization] %d items have no id yet: %s"):format(#unset, table.concat(unset, ", ")))
    end
    return #problems == 0, #unset
end

return M

	local level = R.LEVELS[math.clamp((rebirths or 0) + 1, 1, #R.LEVELS)]

	rebirths = rebirths or 0

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local Q = {}
local BATCH = 16

local pending = {}
local queued = {}
local running = false

local function add(id)
    if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or queued[id] then return end
    if id:match("^rbxasset://") then return end
    queued[id] = true
    pending[#pending + 1] = id
end

local function addInstance(inst)
    if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
        add(inst.MeshId)
        add(inst.TextureID)
    elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
        add(inst.MeshId)
        add(inst.TextureId)
    elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
        add(inst.Texture)
    elseif inst:IsA("ImageLabel") or inst:IsA("ImageButton") then
        add(inst.Image)
    end
end

local function addTree(inst)
    addInstance(inst)
    for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do addInstance(d) end
end

local function worker()
    running = true
    while #pending > 0 do
        local batch = table.create(BATCH)
        for _ = 1, math.min(BATCH, #pending) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = table.remove(pending, 1)
        end
        pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, batch)
    end
    running = false
end

function Q.want(what)
    if typeof(what) == "Instance" then
        addTree(what)
    elseif type(what) == "table" then
        for _, v in ipairs(what) do
            if typeof(v) == "Instance" then addTree(v) else add(v) end
        end
    end
    if #pending > 0 and not running then
        task.spawn(worker)
    end
end

function Q.busy()
    return running or #pending > 0
end

return Q

local LIBRARY = {
	click = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/clickfast.wav", volume = 0.35 },
	open = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch3.wav", volume = 0.4 },
	close = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav", volume = 0.35 },
}

local function build(name, parent)
	local entry = LIBRARY[name]
	if not entry then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "Sfx_" .. name
	sound.SoundId = entry.id
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = entry.pitch or 1
	sound.Looped = entry.looped == true

	sound.Volume = entry.volume or 0.5
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

local uiFolder = nil
local pool = {}

local function uiHome()
	if uiFolder and uiFolder.Parent then
		return uiFolder
	end
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not gui then
		return nil
	end
	uiFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	uiFolder.Name = "Sfx"
	uiFolder.Parent = gui
	return uiFolder
end

function Sfx.play(name)
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		return
	end
	local home = uiHome()
	if not home then
		return
	end
	local sound = pool[name]
	if not sound or not sound.Parent then
		sound = build(name, home)
		pool[name] = sound
	end
	if sound then
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound:Play()
	end
end

return Sfx

function UIKit.repaint(face, tone)
	face.BackgroundColor3 = tone.hi
	local grad = face:FindFirstChild("Gradient")
	if grad then
		local function share(c)
			return Color3.new(
				tone.hi.R > 0 and math.clamp(c.R / tone.hi.R, 0, 1) or 0,
				tone.hi.G > 0 and math.clamp(c.G / tone.hi.G, 0, 1) or 0,
				tone.hi.B > 0 and math.clamp(c.B / tone.hi.B, 0, 1) or 0)
		end
		local height = face:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") or math.max(face.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
		local breakAt = math.clamp(28 / height, 0.12, 0.50)
		grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, WHITE),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(breakAt, share(tone.base)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, share(tone.sh)),
		})
	end
	local bevel = face:FindFirstChild("Bevel")
	if bevel then bevel.BackgroundColor3 = tint(tone.hi, 0.30) end
end

function UIKit.block(props)
	local tone = props.tone or K.row
	local height = props.size.Y.Offset
	local radius = props.radius or math.max(6, math.floor(height * 0.26))
	local anchor = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
	local z = props.zindex or 1

	local shadow
	if props.shadow ~= false then
		shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
		shadow.Name = (props.name or "Block") .. "_Shadow"
		shadow.BackgroundColor3 = K.outline
		shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
		shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
		shadow.AnchorPoint = anchor
		shadow.Size = props.size
		shadow.Position = (props.position or UDim2.new()) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, props.shadowY or 5)
		shadow.ZIndex = z
		shadow.Active = false
		shadow.Parent = props.parent
		corner(shadow, radius)
	end

	local face = Instance.new(props.clickable and "TextButton" or "Frame")
	face.Name = props.name or "Block"
	face.AnchorPoint = anchor
	face.Size = props.size
	face.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
	face.BorderSizePixel = 0
	face.ZIndex = z + 1
	if face:IsA("TextButton") then
		face.Text = ""
		face.AutoButtonColor = false
	end
	face.Parent = props.parent
	corner(face, radius)

	local edgeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	edgeStroke.Thickness = props.outline or 4
	edgeStroke.Color = props.edge or K.outline

	edgeStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	edgeStroke.Parent = face

	if shadow then
		face:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			shadow.Visible = face.Visible
		end)
	end

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Name = "Gradient"
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = face
	face:SetAttribute("BlockHeight", height)
	UIKit.repaint(face, tone)

	if props.finish ~= false then
		local tile = props.stud or STUD_TILE
		local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		studs.Name = "Studs"
		studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		studs.Image = UIKit.ICON.studs
		studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
		studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(tile, tile)

		studs.ImageTransparency = props.studAlpha or 0.55
		studs.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		studs.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
		studs.Active = false
		studs.Parent = face

		corner(studs, radius)
	end

	if props.bevel ~= false then
		local bevelH = math.max(3, math.floor(height * 0.08))
		local bevel = Instance.new("Frame")
		bevel.Name = "Bevel"
		bevel.BackgroundColor3 = tint(tone.hi, 0.30)
		bevel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
		bevel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		bevel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -math.floor(radius * 1.6), 0, bevelH)
		bevel.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(radius * 0.8), 0, math.max(2, math.floor(height * 0.045)))
		bevel.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
		bevel.Active = false
		bevel.Parent = face
		corner(bevel, math.floor(bevelH / 2))
		local bg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		bg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.82, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		bg.Parent = bevel
	end

	local underH = math.min(26, math.max(4, math.floor(height * 0.16)))
	local underside = Instance.new("Frame")
	underside.Name = "Underside"
	underside.BackgroundColor3 = K.outline
	underside.BorderSizePixel = 0
	underside.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, underH)
	underside.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -underH)

		corner(inset, math.max(2, radius - props.inner))
		UIKit.stroke(inset, K.innerOutline, 2, 0.35)
	end

	return face
end

local GROW_ACTIVE, GROW_IDLE = 0.06, 0.025

function UIKit.reactToCursor(face)
	local baseSize, basePos = face.Size, face.Position
	local shadow = face.Parent and face.Parent:FindFirstChild(face.Name .. "_Shadow")
	local shadowPos = shadow and shadow.Position
	local tweens = {}
	local function animate(k)
		for _, t in ipairs(tweens) do t:Cancel() end
		tweens = {}
		local cap = face:GetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow")
		if cap then
			local width = baseSize.X.Offset > 0 and baseSize.X.Scale == 0 and baseSize.X.Offset or face.AbsoluteSize.X
			if width > 0 then
				local limit = cap / width
				k = 1 + math.clamp(k - 1, -limit, limit)
			end
		end
		local dw = math.floor(baseSize.X.Offset * (k - 1) + 0.5)
		local dh = math.floor(baseSize.Y.Offset * (k - 1) + 0.5)
		local dws, dhs = baseSize.X.Scale * (k - 1), baseSize.Y.Scale * (k - 1)
		local size = UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale + dws, baseSize.X.Offset + dw,
			baseSize.Y.Scale + dhs, baseSize.Y.Offset + dh)
		local shiftBy = UDim2.new(-dws / 2, -math.floor(dw / 2), -dhs / 2, -math.floor(dh / 2))
		local moved = face:GetAttribute("MovedBy") or UDim2.new()
		table.insert(tweens, TweenService:Create(face, UIKit.Tween.fast,
			{ Size = size, Position = basePos + moved + shiftBy }))
		if shadow then
			table.insert(tweens, TweenService:Create(shadow, UIKit.Tween.fast,
				{ Size = size, Position = shadowPos + moved + shiftBy }))
		end
		for _, t in ipairs(tweens) do t:Play() end
	end
	local function force()
		return face:GetAttribute("Active") ~= false and GROW_ACTIVE or GROW_IDLE
	end
	face.MouseEnter:Connect(function() animate(1 + force()) end)

		return bar.AbsolutePosition.Y + bar.AbsoluteSize.Y

local function bottomReserve(screen)
	return math.min(BOTTOM_MARGIN, screen * 0.1)
end

function UIKit.fitWindow(root, scale, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local function recompute()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return scale.Scale end
		local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
		local screen = cam.ViewportSize.Y - inset
		local headroom = root:GetAttribute("FitHeadRoom") or 0
		local height = math.max(root.Size.Y.Offset, 1) + headroom
		local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
		local top = opts.topReserve or (small and 4 or (topReserve() + HUD_GAP))
		local bottom = opts.bottomReserve or (small and 4 or bottomReserve(screen))

		local width = math.max(root.Size.X.Offset, 1)
		local byHeight = (screen - top - bottom) / height
		local byWidth = (cam.ViewportSize.X - SIDE_MARGIN * 2) / width

		local target = root:GetAttribute("FitTargetHeight")
		local s = math.min(byHeight, byWidth, target and target / height or 1)
		s = math.max(s, small and 0.3 or 0.43)
		scale.Scale = s

		local half = height * s / 2
		local highest, lowest = top + half, screen - bottom - half

		local centre = (lowest < highest) and (screen / 2)
			or math.clamp(screen / 2, highest, lowest)

		local sg = root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
		local shift = (sg and sg.IgnoreGuiInset) and inset or 0
		root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.floor(centre + shift + headroom * s / 2))

		local shadow = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChild(root.Name .. "_Shadow")
		if shadow then
			shadow.AnchorPoint = root.AnchorPoint
			shadow.Position = root.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, SHADOW_FADE)
			local sc = shadow:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
			if not sc then
				sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
				sc.Parent = shadow
			end
			sc.Scale = s
		end
		return s
	end
	recompute()

	local function track(cam)
		if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(recompute) end
	end
	track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
		recompute()
	end)

	return recompute
end

			local k = g.Color.Keypoints
			top = mul(bg, k[1].Value)
			base = mul(bg, k[math.min(2, #k)].Value)
		end
		fg.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, base)
		rim.BackgroundColor3 = base:Lerp(BLACK, 0.45)
	end
	shade()
	b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(shade)
	local g = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g then

	end
	local function light(on)
		local lit = on and b:GetAttribute("Active") ~= false
		TweenService:Create(glow, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = lit and 0.8 or 1 }):Play()
	end

	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

	end)
	for _, t in b:GetDescendants() do
		if t:IsA("TextLabel") then
			local s = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if s then

			end
		end
	end
	local label = b:FindFirstChild("Label")
	local sym = label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and (label.Text == "+" or label.Text == "-") and label.Text
	if sym then
		label.TextTransparency = 1
		local ls = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

			ls.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	local signs = {}
	for _, c in b:GetChildren() do
		if c.Name == "Sign" and c:IsA("Frame") then
			table.insert(signs, c)
		end
	end
	if not sym and #signs > 0 then
		sym = #signs >= 4 and "+" or "-"
		for _, c in signs do
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	if sym then
		local inset = math.max(3, math.floor(h * 0.1))
		local box = Instance.new("Frame")
		box.Name = "Symbol"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.Active = false

		box.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.6)
		box.ZIndex = z + 6
		box.Parent = b
		Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint").Parent = box
		for i, look in { { INK, 0 }, { WHITE, inset } } do
			for _, angle in (sym == "+" and { 0, 90 } or { 0 }) do
				local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
				bar.Name = i == 1 and "BarOutline" or "Bar"
				bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -look[2], 0.36, -look[2])
				bar.Rotation = angle
				bar.BackgroundColor3 = look[1]
				bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
				bar.Active = false
				bar.ZIndex = z + 6 + i
				bar.Parent = box
				corner(bar, 3)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function shownColours(o, g)
	local bg = o.BackgroundColor3
	if not g then
		return { bg }
	end
	local k = g.Color.Keypoints
	if k[1].Value == WHITE and bg ~= WHITE then
		return { bg, mul(bg, k[math.min(2, #k)].Value) }
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, p in k do
		table.insert(out, mul(bg, p.Value))
	end
	return out
end

local function vivid(colours)
	for _, c in colours do
		local _, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		if s > 0.3 and v > 0.25 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function sequence(colours)
	if #colours == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(colours[1])
	end
	local points = {}
	for i, c in colours do
		table.insert(points, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((i - 1) / (#colours - 1), c))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(points)
end

local function colourCard(o, g, side, alpha)
	g.Enabled = true
	local rim = innerRim(o, BLACK, 0)
	local function paint()
		local uikit = g.Color.Keypoints[1].Value == WHITE and o.BackgroundColor3 ~= WHITE
		local colours = shownColours(o, g)
		if uikit then
			local _, _, v = colours[2]:ToHSV()
			if v < 0.62 then
				colours = { SKY[1], SKY[2] }
			else
				colours = { colours[2], colours[2]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.4) }
			end
		end
		o.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		g.Color = sequence(colours)
		local dark = colours[#colours]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.45)
		setRim(rim, dark)
		for _, d in o:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("Frame") and d.Parent ~= rim and d.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and d.Size.Y.Offset > 0
				and d.Size.Y.Offset <= 6 and d.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and not d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiButton") then
				d.BackgroundColor3 = dark
				d.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				for _, c in d:GetChildren() do
					if c:IsA("UICorner") or c:IsA("UIGradient") then
						c:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	paint()
	o.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0.1
	edge(o, 3, INK)
	studs(o, 0.6, math.clamp(math.floor(side * 0.12), 6, 14))
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(function()
		if o.BackgroundColor3 ~= WHITE then
			paint()
		end
	end)
end

local function whiteText(o)
	for _, t in o:GetDescendants() do
		if t:IsA("TextLabel") then
			local c = t.TextColor3
			if 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B < 0.3 then
				t.TextColor3 = WHITE
				t.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
				local s = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
				s.Color = INK
				s.Thickness = math.max(s.Thickness, 2)
				s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
				s.Parent = t
			end
		end
	end
end

function S.card(o, key)
	if o:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned") then
		return
	end
	o:SetAttribute("WindowSkinned", true)
	local normal = o.BackgroundColor3
	square(o)
	local size = o.AbsoluteSize
	local side = (size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0) and math.min(size.X, size.Y) or heightOf(o)
	local g = o:FindFirstChild("Gradient") or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g and vivid(shownColours(o, g)) then
		colourCard(o, g, side, key and SEE_THROUGH[key])
		whiteText(o)
		return
	end
	if g then
		g.Enabled = false
	end
	o.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
	o.BackgroundTransparency = S.CardAlpha
	local line = edge(o, 2, CARD_EDGE)
	studs(o, 0.62, math.clamp(math.floor(side * 0.15), 6, 16))
	whiteText(o)
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(function()
		local c = o.BackgroundColor3
		if c == CARD then
			return
		end
		local marked = c ~= normal
		line.Color = marked and c or CARD_EDGE
		line.Thickness = marked and 3 or 2
		o.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
	end)
end

function S.content(panel)
	local root = panel
	if panel.Name == "Frame" and panel.Parent and panel.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
		root = panel.Parent
	end
	for _, o in root:GetDescendants() do
		if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") and not o:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned")
			and not o:FindFirstChild("Header") and not inHeader(o, root) and not insideSkinned(o, root) then
			local c = o.BackgroundColor3
			local light = 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B > 0.85
			local label = o:FindFirstChild("Label") or o:FindFirstChild("Text")
			local buttonLike = o:GetAttribute("SkinButtonLook")
				or (label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Size == UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) and heightOf(o) < 100)
			if o:IsA("GuiButton") or buttonLike then
				S.button(o)
			elseif heightOf(o) >= 50 or (light and heightOf(o) >= 30) then
				S.card(o, keyOf(panel))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function movable(c, head)
	if not c:IsA("GuiObject") or c == head or DECOR[c.Name] or c.Position.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return not (c.Size.Y.Scale >= 1 and c.Position.Y.Offset <= 0)
end

local function shiftUp(c, delta)
	if c:GetAttribute("SkinShifted") then
		return
	end
	c:SetAttribute("SkinShifted", true)
	c.Position -= UDim2.fromOffset(0, delta)
	c:SetAttribute("MovedBy", UDim2.fromOffset(0, -delta))
	if c.Size.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
		c.Size += UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.floor(c.Size.Y.Scale * delta + 0.5))
	end
end

local function straddle(panel, head)
	local list = {}
	local top = math.huge
	for _, c in panel:GetChildren() do
		if movable(c, head) then
			table.insert(list, c)
			local h = c.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and c.Size.Y.Offset or 0
			top = math.min(top, c.Position.Y.Offset - c.AnchorPoint.Y * h)
		end
	end
	local delta = top - (HEAD / 2 + 14)
	if top == math.huge or delta <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	for _, c in list do
		shiftUp(c, delta)
	end
	panel.Size -= UDim2.fromOffset(0, delta)
	panel.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		task.defer(function()
			if c.Parent == panel and movable(c, head) then
				shiftUp(c, delta)
			end
		end)
	end)
	return delta
end

	studs(panel, 0.82, 24)
	innerRim(panel, BODY_RIM, 0.3)

	head.ClipsDescendants = false

		end

		end
	end)

		end
	end)

		end
	end)
	edge(head, 4, INK)
	studs(head, 0.72, 20)
	innerRim(head, pal[1]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.4), 0)

	local icon = head:FindFirstChild("Icon")
	for _, c in head:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("ImageLabel") and c.Name ~= "Studs" then
			if c.Name:match("Shadow$") then
				c.Visible = false
			elseif not (icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
				icon = c
			end
		end
	end
	if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0.5, -4)
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(HEAD + 34, HEAD + 34)
		titleX = HEAD + 32
	end
	local extra = 0
	for _, c in head:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiButton") and c.Name ~= "Close" and c:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") then
			extra = math.max(extra, c.Size.X.Offset + 14)
			S.button(c)
		end
	end
	local title = head:FindFirstChild("Title")
	if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
		local function fix()
			local t = titleCase(title.Text)
			if title.Text ~= t then
				title.Text = t
			end
		end
		fix()
		title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fix)
		local right = (head:FindFirstChild("Close") and HEAD or 16) + extra + 8
		title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, titleX, 0.5, 0)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(titleX + right), 0.8, 0)
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextScaled = true
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
		local lim = title:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		lim.MinTextSize = 14
		lim.MaxTextSize = 64
		lim.Parent = title
		local ts = title:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if ts then
			ts.Thickness = 2.5
			ts.Color = INK
		end
		local ghost = head:FindFirstChild("Title_Shadow")
		if ghost then
			ghost.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local close = head:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if close then
		S.close(close)
		local face = close:FindFirstChild("SkinFace")
		local p, s, a = close.Position, close.Size, close.AnchorPoint
		if face and p.X.Scale == 1 and s.X.Scale == 0 and s.Y.Scale == 0 then
			local side = face.Size.X.Offset
			local cx = p.X.Offset + (0.5 - a.X) * s.X.Offset
			local cy = p.Y.Scale * HEAD + p.Y.Offset + (0.5 - a.Y) * s.Y.Offset
			face.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.floor(-(12 + side / 2) - cx), 0.5, math.floor(HEAD / 2 - cy))
		end
	end

	local sg = panel:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	local global = sg and sg.ZIndexBehavior == Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
	local topZ = 0
	for _, c in (global and panel:GetDescendants() or panel:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= head and not c:IsDescendantOf(head) then
			topZ = math.max(topZ, c.ZIndex)
		end
	end
	raise(head, topZ + 1 - head.ZIndex)

	local delta = straddle(panel, head)
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinShift", delta)
	if SIDE[key] then
		panel.Position -= UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0)
		local shell = panel.Parent
		if shell and shell:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local groups = {}
			local function frameFor(name, dy)
				if not groups[name] then
					local f = Instance.new("Frame")
					f.Name = name
					f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					f.Active = false
					f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-14, dy)
					f.ZIndex = panel.ZIndex + 1
					f.Parent = shell
					groups[name] = f
				end
				return groups[name]
			end
			local h = shell.Size.Y.Offset
			local below, belowTop = {}, math.huge
			for _, c in shell:GetChildren() do
				if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= panel and c.Name ~= panel.Name .. "_Shadow" then
					local y = c.Position.Y
					if y.Scale == 0.5 then
						c.Parent = frameFor("SkinSideMiddle", -math.floor((HEAD / 2 + delta) / 2))
					elseif y.Scale == 1 or (y.Scale == 0 and y.Offset > h / 2) then
						table.insert(below, c)
						if not c.Name:match("_Shadow$") then
							local sh = c.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and c.Size.Y.Offset or 0
							belowTop = math.min(belowTop, y.Scale * h + y.Offset - c.AnchorPoint.Y * sh)
						end
					else
						c.Parent = frameFor("SkinSideTop", 0)
					end
				end
			end
			if #below > 0 and belowTop < math.huge then
				local bottom = panel.Position.Y.Scale * h + panel.Position.Y.Offset
					+ (1 - panel.AnchorPoint.Y) * panel.Size.Y.Offset
				local f = frameFor("SkinSideBelow", math.floor(bottom + 10 - belowTop))
				for _, c in below do
					c.Parent = f
				end
			end
		end
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinOldHead", oldHead)
	S.content(panel)
end

local function available()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		return S.TargetHeight, 1000
	end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local small = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) < 500
	local room = vp.Y - (small and 16 or (GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y + 110))
	return math.min(S.TargetHeight, room), vp.X - 24
end

function S.normalize(panel)
	if KEEP_SIZE[keyOf(panel)] or panel:GetAttribute("SkinNormalized") then
		return
	end
	local holder = panel
	local sc
	while holder and holder:IsA("GuiObject") do
		sc = holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if sc then
			break
		end
		holder = holder.Parent
	end
	if not sc then
		return
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinNormalized", true)
	local function wanted()
		local h, w = available()
		local visualH = panel.Size.Y.Offset + HEAD / 2
		local visualW = panel.Size.X.Offset + 20
		return math.min(h / math.max(visualH, 1), w / math.max(visualW, 1))
	end
	if holder ~= panel then
		local own = Instance.new("UIScale")
		own.Name = "SkinScale"
		own.Parent = panel
		local shift = panel:GetAttribute("SkinShift") or 0
		if panel.Position.X.Scale == 0 and panel.Position.Y.Scale == 0 and panel.AnchorPoint == Vector2.zero then
			local size = panel.Size
			panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset / 2, 0, (size.Y.Offset + shift + HEAD / 2) / 2)
		end
		local steady = sc.Scale
		local shelf
		local function place()
			if shelf then
				local w = panel.Size.X.Offset
				local extra = panel.Position.X.Offset + (w / 2 + 10) * own.Scale - holder.Size.X.Offset
				shelf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(0, math.ceil(extra)), 0)
			end
		end
		local function apply()
			own.Scale = wanted() / math.max(steady, 0.05)
			place()
		end
		local function consider(c)
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= panel and c ~= shelf and c.Position.X.Scale == 1
				and c.Size.X.Scale == 0 and c.Size.X.Offset > 0 then
				if not shelf then
					shelf = Instance.new("Frame")
					shelf.Name = "SkinOutside"
					shelf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					shelf.Active = false
					shelf.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					shelf.ZIndex = panel.ZIndex + 2
					shelf.Parent = holder
				end
				c.Parent = shelf
				place()
			end
		end
		for _, c in holder:GetChildren() do
			consider(c)
		end
		holder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
			task.defer(consider, c)
		end)
		local stamp = 0
		sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
			stamp += 1
			local mine = stamp
			task.delay(0.4, function()
				if mine == stamp then
					steady = sc.Scale
					apply()
				end
			end)
		end)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(apply)
		end
		apply()
	else
		panel:SetAttribute("FitHeadRoom", HEAD / 2)
		panel:SetAttribute("FitTargetHeight", S.TargetHeight * (panel:GetAttribute("SkinSizeFactor") or 1))
	end
end

function S.watch(panel)
	if panel:GetAttribute("SkinWatched") then
		return
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinWatched", true)
	task.wait(0.1)
	S.window(panel)
	local queued = false
	local function queue()
		if queued then
			return
		end
		queued = true
		task.defer(function()
			queued = false
			S.content(panel)
		end)
	end
	local root = (panel.Name == "Frame" and panel.Parent and panel.Parent:IsA("GuiObject")) and panel.Parent or panel
	root.DescendantAdded:Connect(queue)
	local o = panel
	while o and o:IsA("GuiObject") do
		o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(queue)
		o = o.Parent
	end
	S.normalize(panel)
end

return S
